description: Retrieves football/soccer statistics from FBref.com including team squad stats, competition tables, and player statistics. Handles Cloudflare protection with anti-detection measures.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_squad_stats: 获取球队阵容统计数据，需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_competition_stats: 获取联赛/杯赛统计数据，需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_player_stats: 获取球员统计数据，需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - search_teams: 搜索球队，需要query参数; 参数: query; 必填: query
